brief: A tool caddy with a carry handle and divided bins for screws and bits.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Linear 3-cell base (piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) with side connectors joining cells, forming a portable tray. Capped open faces and locked joints.
Central cover cover:0,0,0;full;top with handle:0,0,0;top mounted on three inserts (60°,180°,300°), centered between the two bin cells for balanced carrying.

requirements.requirement: Divided bins for screws and bits
requirements.evidence: Two divided bins: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments). Dressed with heap-screws-div2 in both compartments of left bin and heap-screws-div3 in two compartments of right bin, plus screwdriver in third compartment to represent bits/drivers. All compartments visible from above (polar 10 view).

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell tool caddy with central carry handle and two divided bins (2-compartment and 3-compartment) providing 5 compartments for screws and bits, staged with screw heaps and a driver to show use. All mesh and rule checks clear.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
